images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original premium pixel-art background plate for a side-view web runner, NOT a screenshot or UI. Landscape panorama, wide 16:9. Pixel art with a deliberate 320x180 logical pixel grid enlarged crisply: visible square pixels, 2-3 tone clusters, textured foliage/brick/roof details, atmospheric depth, no vector geometry, no gradients or smoothed edges. Elegant restrained palette: warm ivory sky, sage/forest greens, oxide terracotta, dark slate, brass, cream highlights, muted rather than neon. Visually substantial and beautifully composed like a carefully art-directed indie game; no simplistic repeated identical houses. Three distinct depth bands with large far scenic shapes, varied middle architecture/trees, lower unobtrusive verge. Side elevation, no isometric camera. Lower 25% is a quiet continuous earthy strip with no obstacles, no character, no text, no HUD, no icons, no logos. Left and right edges must share the same sky/low ridge/floor colors for horizontal looping; keep important silhouettes away from edges. Distant scenery only, movement and animated sprites will be layered in code. Soft directional sunlight and believable depth in chunky pixels. Varied organic composition, abundant rich environmental pixel detail, golden harvest mood. No people or vehicles.
